assets.title: Eight-Gore Seamed Pin Cushion
assets.description: One original low round pin cushion with eight visibly depressed radial gores, a tucked top centre and a recessed continuous waist seam. The cushion is a single closed bulging surface with a finite flat bottom. Its warm ivory waist is a material assignment on recessed geometry, never an overlay or texture. Five fixed slender steel-colour pins have matching faceted amber ball heads; each shaft has a short tapered lower end embedded well inside the cushion and an upper end embedded in its head. Eleven separately editable closed meshes, four solid PBR materials, no texture or external dependency. Metres, source Z up and ground-centre origin. The complete cushion-and-pins arrangement counts as one prop, not five pin assets. Only the pictured static pose is checked. No cloth, sewing, insertion, puncture or motion simulation; no real material, needle safety, puncture resistance, child suitability, manufacture or tool performance guarantee.
